description: Sign maps of the mean dynamics of the sign-error LMS loops (GOS = DTC gain, PHOS = 8 PMUX phase offsets) in a fractional-N SSPLL. Values are the eigenvalues of the regressor correlation matrix C (time-averaged x_i[n-D] (h_PD * x_j)[n]); the mean update is delta_{k+1} = (I - mu K_q C) delta_k, so Re(eig) < 0 => that mode diverges (sign flip).

units.alpha: fraction of FCW (VCO periods per ref cycle); f_offset = alpha*f_ref
units.C_gos: dimensionless (rho in units of T_vco/8); multiply by K_q*(T_vco/8)^2 for physical gain
units.lam: eigenvalues of the 8x8 PHOS matrix; lam_0 = 0 (common mode, unobservable)

grid.alpha: (2i+1)/4096, i=0..2047 (period Q=4096 for every point, 8|Q -> exact circulant)
grid.beta_curve: beta_j=(2j+1)/8192 in (0,0.5): GOS vs sawtooth line frequency beta*f_ref
grid.alpha_zoom: odd/2^18 near geomspace(0.5,500 MHz)/f_ref: exact PHOS modes (DFT, period 2^18)

conventions.rho: rho[n] = frac(8 n alpha) = DTC residue in units of T_vco/8 (non-negative; mean drops out since H_PD(1)=0)
conventions.D: correlator code delay: G_i = mean q[n] x_i[n-D]; D=0 is aligned (h_PD[0]=1 direct feed-through)
conventions.lam_m: lam_m = v_m^H C v_m with v_m[k] = e^{j2pi m k/8}/sqrt(8) (eigenvalues when C is circulant)
